placements.why: All five segments carry the same thematic content already held by this leaf: a technology-stack swap (PostgreSQL → QuantumDB) ratified by quantified performance and cost figures. src-1 announces the switch, src-2 states the performance/cost rationale, and src-3/4/5 restate that same migration, performance gain, and timeline as a compressed summary — no new theme beyond what this leaf already names, so the existing leaf is reused rather than minting a duplicate.
